items.title: Meal plans your way
items.body: Name your plans, pick the meals for each day (weekday dinners, lunch too at the weekend) and set the dates each one runs. Fuel › Plan.

items.title: Just ate? Tap +
items.body: Fuel shows your next planned meal with Ate it and Swap. The lime + logs a planned meal, a recent recipe or a palm of protein in two taps.

items.title: Train, tidier
items.body: Coach Monkey shows your week as three tiles, and the day card puts Add workout and Plan sport side by side.
